plan.baseline_prompt:
You are a helpful conversational assistant. A teacher or caregiver is discussing a student's mathematics learning. Respond in English, engage naturally with what they say, ask a relevant follow-up when useful, and provide helpful practical advice when asked. Do not assume that all the information is known.
For the common interface only: return JSON with phase (question, summary, or safety_escalation), reply (your actual answer), questionFocus, coverage (confirmed domain keys), and suggestedReplies (empty array). Use one focused question on question turns. Domain keys are trajectory, confidence, classroom, support_timing, context_safety. When asked for a final summary, write one natural paragraph of approximately 80-140 English words, without headings or bullets. Do not expose interface bookkeeping in the reply.
plan.comparison_scope: Same base model, scripted English user updates, facts, order, turn budget, final length instruction. Compare final reply quality, not adaptive questioning skill. Agent includes actual app prompt, validation and safety middleware; baseline has neutral ordinary-assistant instructions plus the same interface schema/validator. No attribution to a single component.
plan.generation_policy: All API attempts, finish reasons, model IDs and usage retained. At most four transport attempts per call (5/10/20-second backoff). Actual app allows one format-repair call; baseline has the same allowance. Failed conversations remain failed; no content/quality-based reruns. No automatic teacher ratings or winner.

teacher_evaluation.scale: 1 very poor, 2 poor, 3 adequate, 4 good, 5 very good; dimension-specific anchors must be provided before scoring
teacher_evaluation.raters: Two independent teachers, blinded A/B, randomized order, originals unmodified
teacher_evaluation.secondary_outcomes: remaining three dimensions; report all with multiplicity-aware interpretation
teacher_evaluation.analysis: Case is the cluster; repetitions are not independent students. Report paired case-level differences with case-cluster bootstrap CI; inter-rater agreement; no weighted composite ranking. Small n=12 and exploratory inference disclosed.

contextual relevance.1: Misses the central concern or is largely unrelated.
contextual relevance.3: Addresses the concern but includes generic or distracting material or misses an important relevant point.
contextual relevance.5: Focuses on the case-relevant concern and priorities without treating neutral background as a problem.

consistency with case facts.1: Invents or contradicts a central fact or states an unsupported individual cause as established.
consistency with case facts.3: Mostly consistent but contains a material unsupported inference or insufficiently qualified interpretation.
consistency with case facts.5: Faithfully uses the supplied facts, distinguishes unknown from absent, and keeps conclusions within what those facts support.

appropriateness and actionability of sug.1: Advice is unsuitable, unsafe, or not usable for this case.
appropriateness and actionability of sug.3: Advice is broadly suitable but insufficiently specific or poorly adapted to the available information.
appropriateness and actionability of sug.5: Proposes feasible, concrete first steps appropriate to the case and its uncertainties; requesting missing information or prioritizing safety can be fully appropriate.

clarity.3: Understandable overall but contains unnecessary jargon, repetition, or unclear organization.
clarity.5: Clear, coherent, concise and accessible to a teacher or caregiver.

dimension_anchors.intermediate_scores: 2 lies between 1 and 3; 4 lies between 3 and 5. Do not reward length, statistical jargon, or agreement with a preferred system. A score of 5 does not establish diagnostic correctness or real-world educational benefit.

limitations: These 12 synthetic cases were previously examined and used in development; not unseen validation.
Predefined staged updates may not answer the exact follow-up question; same updates for both groups isolate final-reply comparison.
Ordinary LLM does not receive the agent research prompt; this is a full-system comparison, not DML ablation.
New English conversation outputs cannot replace or relabel old report experiments.
plan.rubric_status: Adapted task-specific rubric, NOT a validated educational diagnostic scale. Teacher review pending.
